Subject: Prep for investor packet — ARR / bookings evidence request

Hi Irene / Vanessa,

Board is meeting the week of Oct 26 and our CFO asked for a clear, auditable package for the renewal with Redwood (GaleTech renewal). Specifically: a short cover note, the committed ARR number we expect to book in Q4, supporting evidence for each commit (PO, signed SOW, contract amendment), and a reconciliation of any pipeline-to-booking deltas.

Can you confirm what you need from us to make the investor packet? Our internal finance team can pull PO/SOWs but we need a runbook from Redwood that maps your commit states to what you include for the board.

Requested timeline:
- Can you share the final commit number (ARR) you will include by EOD Wed Oct 21?
- We can provide signed documents by Oct 23.

Thanks — want to make this as frictionless as possible.

Kate Nolan
Head of Finance, GaleTech
kate@gale-tech.com

Attachments: (none in this email)
From: irene.choi@redwood.com <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prep for investor packet — ARR / bookings evidence request

Kate — thanks for the heads up. Quick responses and ask list below so we can produce an auditable packet the board can consume.

What we'll include from Redwood (deliverable for your board pack):
- Final committed ARR number we will recognize in Q4 (single line item) with explanation of recognition timing if partial quarters apply.
- A short cover memo that explains methodology (which pipeline stages we treat as 'commit', any SCO or payment conditions).
- Per-deal evidence checklist: required items (signed PO/SOW, signed contract, customer acceptance where applicable).
- Reconciliation worksheet that ties pipeline records to the booking(s) and highlights any blocked line items.

What we need from GaleTech to complete exactly as requested:
- Signed SOW(s) or linked DocuSign envelope IDs for deals you expect to close.
- Any internal approval notes that your finance team requires to accept the booking (PO numbers, internal reference).
- If any deals are partial (phased rollout), indicate the install/acceptance milestones.

I attached a short handoff template to make this quick — fill any columns you can and send back (redwood_forecast_handoff_template.xlsx). We'll validate and produce the board-ready packet.

Timeline we will commit to from Redwood:
- Please return the filled handoff by Fri Oct 22 EOD PT.
- Redwood will produce the draft investor packet and return to you by Mon Oct 25 for final sign-off.
- Final packet delivered Tue Oct 26 AM PT so you can include in board materials.

If Vanessa or Vivek want to propose a different commit number prior to the template, please flag.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate evidence pulls on our side once we receive the template.

Irene Choi
Director, Revenue Operations (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_forecast_handoff_template.xlsx

Action items for this thread:

- Vivek: please pull the DocuSign envelope IDs and attach to the evidence pack (if available).
- Ben: help chase finance@gale-tech.com for the missing PO reference for GT-00127 — need by Fri 10/22.

I will compile the cover memo language once Irene confirms the number.

— Vanessa Ortiz
